def _class_member_obligations(
        self, owner: _FlowValue, member_name: str | None,
        values: Mapping[str, _FlowValue], *, include_inherited: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[_FlowValue, ...]:
        self.budget.consume()
        if (not owner.authority_refs and not owner.helper_obligations
                and owner.kind not in {"implicit_class", "implicit_class_instance",
                                       "maybe_unbound", "implicit_protocol_merged"}):
            return ()
        identities, _unresolved, issues = self._class_member_owner_ids(
            owner, values, instance_read=True, member_lookup=include_inherited,
        )
        self.budget.consume(2 + len(issues))
        roots: list[_FlowValue] = list(issues)
        store = self._authority(values)
        for identity in identities:
            self.budget.consume(2)
            record = store.objects.get(identity)
            if record is None:
                issue = _new_retained_value(
                    self.budget, "helper_deferred_refusal",
                    reason="helper namespace authority state is unresolved",
                )
                self.budget.consume()
                roots.append(issue)
                continue
            self.budget.consume()
            for name, supplied in record.member_obligations:
                self.budget.consume()
                if member_name is None or name == member_name:
                    self.budget.consume(1 + 2 * len(supplied))
                    roots.extend(supplied)
            self.budget.consume(1 + 2 * len(record.member_wildcard))
            roots.extend(record.member_wildcard)
        self.budget.consume(2)
        return _ordered_flow_roots((roots,), self.budget)

def _lexicographic_comparison_values(
        self, value: _FlowValue,
    ) -> Iterable[_FlowValue]:
        # Each yield lets the existing protocol projection run before the next
        # content read; no old flattened child list survives those effects.
        self.budget.consume()
        if self._current_effect_values is not None:
            value = self._current_collection_read_value(value, self._current_effect_values)
        yield value
        index = 0
        while True:
            if self._current_effect_values is not None:
                value = self._current_collection_read_value(value, self._current_effect_values)
            if (value.kind != "sequence"
                    or value.container_kind not in {None, "list", "tuple"}
                    or index >= len(value.value)):
                return
            self.budget.consume(3)
            item = value.value[index]
            index += 1
            yield from self._lexicographic_comparison_values(item)
